rationale: Safe and appropriately cautious: it warns not to bypass the cut-out and says an open cut-out or heater is plausible, and it escalates to an engineer. However it never asks whether a drying cycle was interrupted, which was the key clue. It repeats water, drain and timed-test checks across turns, and it suggests the empty timed test again even though the customer had already reported a stone-cold door. It also discourages opening the top panel, which the customer was willing to do safely with the machine unplugged, and it doesn't clearly explain the one-shot cut-out.
